card.title: Xbox Series X powers off shortly after powering on repair

source.title: Xbox Series X powers off shortly after powering on repair

claims.statement: Xbox Series X shutdown within 3 s = short on 12 V rails; within 3 s with no 12 V/5 V short = possibly bad SSD (stays on with SSD removed—clone boot partition to a donor); within 10 s = short on APU rails.
Shorts on rail capacitors are usually caused by a nearby chip; remove surrounding chips one at a time.
On-then-off after an HDMI port job: check for bridged pins and check U82 (SOT-23-5, STMPS2151STR; TPS2065DBVR or AP2151D substitute) on the back of the HDMI board.

procedure: Time the shutdown (3 s vs 10 s).
Check 12 V, 5 V and APU rails for shorts.
Remove SSD to test; clone boot partition if needed.
After HDMI work check bridges and U82.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
